description: This file defines React components for a contribution form, including input handling, form submission, and UI rendering for resource links related to a topic.

methods.name: ContributionInput
methods.description: React component for inputting a resource title and link, with add/remove functionality.

methods.name: ContributionForm
methods.description: Main React component for submitting multiple resource links related to a topic, with validation and toast notifications.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, posts data to API, manages loading state, and triggers success or error notifications.
